frequency_question: What proportion of scheduled major union strike actions officially commence on or before the definitive deadline rather than being called off or delayed past the threshold?
membership_rule: Includes announced indefinite or general strikes by recognized national union federations with a strict calendar deadline; excludes wildcat strikes without formal federation backing or vague protest actions lacking a specific commencement threshold.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association / UFBU past strike threats

coverage_note: 10 representative cases sampled from major union strike notices in the jurisdiction, capturing both executed strikes and last-minute conciliation settlements.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional or single-bank disputes that did not reach national federation level.
skeleton: 10 historical instances of union strike notices with strict deadlines, tracking whether conciliation talks resolved the dispute or delayed the action past the cutoff.
validity_reason: Labor relations frameworks and conciliation machinery change slowly over multi-year cycles.
